# ICrossChainArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/ICrossChainArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IInflightAssetTracking](./i-inflight-asset-tracking.md)

**Title:**
ICrossChainArk

Interface for the CrossChainArk contract which manages cross-chain assets

Extends IInflightAssetTracking for consistent inflight asset management


## Events
### MessageContentNotExpected
Emitted when a message is not expected


```solidity
event MessageContentNotExpected();
```

### PendingTransferQueued
Emitted when a pending transfer is queued


```solidity
event PendingTransferQueued(BridgeTypes.ExecuteTransferParams params, BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions options);
```

### RemoteAssetBalanceUpdated
Emitted when the remote asset balance is updated via state read


```solidity
event RemoteAssetBalanceUpdated(uint256 newBalance, bytes32 requestId);
```

### AssetsReceived
Emitted when assets are received from another chain


```solidity
event AssetsReceived(address indexed token, uint256 amount, uint16 sourceChainId);
```

### RemoteAssetBalanceUpdateRequested
Emitted when a remote asset balance update is requested


```solidity
event RemoteAssetBalanceUpdateRequested(bytes32 indexed queueId, uint16 targetChainId, address targetProxy);
```

### InvalidTransferId
Emitted when a transfer ID is invalid.


```solidity
event InvalidTransferId(bytes32 latestTransferReceivedInFleetProxy, bytes32 latestOutgoingTransferId);
```

## Errors
### InvalidSatelliteChain
Thrown when the provided satellite chain ID is zero.


```solidity
error InvalidSatelliteChain();
```

### InvalidMessageId
Thrown when a message ID is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidMessageId();
```

### InvalidRequestId
Thrown when a request ID is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidRequestId();
```

### InvalidSourceChain
Thrown when the source chain ID is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidSourceChain();
```

### InvalidRecipient
Thrown when the recipient address is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidRecipient();
```

### InvalidRequestor
Thrown when the requestor address is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidRequestor();
```

### ReceiveMessageWithAssetsNotSupported
Thrown when receiveOperation(BridgeTypes.OperationType.TRANSFER_ASSET,abi.encode( is called (not
supported for this Ark).


```solidity
error ReceiveMessageWithAssetsNotSupported();
```

### InsufficientAssets
Thrown when there are insufficient assets on the contract to perform the withdrawal.


```solidity
error InsufficientAssets(uint256 requestedAmount, uint256 availableAmount);
```

### InvalidAsset
Thrown when the provided asset address is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidAsset();
```

### InvalidAmount
Thrown when the provided amount is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidAmount();
```

### InvalidBridgeRouter
Thrown when the provided bridge router address is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidBridgeRouter();
```

### InvalidCrossChainRegistry
Thrown when the provided cross chain registry address is invalid.


```solidity
error InvalidCrossChainRegistry();
```

### NoPendingTransferQueued
Thrown when there are no pending transfer params.


```solidity
error NoPendingTransferQueued();
```

### PendingTransferAlreadyQueued
Thrown when there are pending transfer params already queued.


```solidity
error PendingTransferAlreadyQueued();
```
